changes: Canvas dimension/default dialogs use 16-point margins, 12-point rounded frames, 24-point headings, 16-point body text, readable secondary text and 40-point fields/actions. The Dimensions group spans the body. Bodies shrink to contents on roomy displays and scroll with a reserved visible scrollbar when constrained, keeping acceptance actions outside the scroller. Host resize/default-policy behavior is unchanged.

gui.scope: Full UI suite passes. Existing canvas-dialog tests cover light/dark wide/compact and 1x/2x repeated layout, fixed/reachable actions during scrolling, staged dimensions/policy cancellation, preference bytes and history preservation, actual defaults/remembered sizes and restart behavior.

gpu.scope: Ten raw light/dark scenes: current/default dialogs at 1360x900 and 360x360, plus scrolled compact default-policy controls.

checks: Formatting, whitespace and source file length checks passed.
limits: App-specific canvas/default-size presentation follows shared Classic surfaces; no native Paint canvas-dialog close-up was supplied, so exact native Properties parity is not claimed. Existing shared dialog consumers inherit the styling. No new resize policy, document operation or performance claim.
